reviews.verdict: NEW CHARACTER WINS INTERNAL A/B; COMMERCIAL BAR FAILS
reviews.finding: Fresh critic inspected 16 matched real-render frames without source/version labels and preferred A (new Ember) throughout. Basic static two-hand attachment passes. Garment/anatomy/material finish, explicit heal/reload interactions and terminal-pose grounding remain gaps. Frozen-position running frames do not prove locomotion.

Unfrozen baseline: 8 frames/11.58 s; a repeat achieved 16/10.05 s, demonstrating large host variance. Lower resolution, conservative instance culling and normal GPU launch flags did not establish usable playback or a robust gain. Client snapshots can advance before actually rendered ticks; end-of-probe rendered lag remained 5.10–6.25 seconds in two controls. These experimental changes were not landed.
Two independent critiques exposed checkpoint yaw, action/resource, lifecycle and strict-schema defects. Repairs and 11 authority regression checks pass.
Independent review reproduced and verified repair of render freezes, context-loss status, late fetch/JSON races, BFCache restoration, restart cursors and an early-recovery deadlock.
Independent review accepted material sharing, animation, restoration and disposal. Actual continuous software rendering remains too slow.
